notes.title: Ver1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
Ver1.0.1 Update

・Game optimization has been implemented.
・The effects for the Stranger have been adjusted.
・A bug with the Hide Hand has been fixed.
・A feature to display the completion time after clearing has been added.
・Some changes have been made to the lighting specifications.
・Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Ver1.0.1 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Ver1.0.1 Update Announcement

An update will be released soon with the following changes:

・Game optimization
・Changes to the Stranger's direction
・Bug fix for the Hide Hand
・Addition of a feature to display completion time after clearing
・We will make some changes to the lighting specifications
・Minor bug fixes
